notes.title: 1.0.3 Update Notice
notes.notes:
When the following recipe was posted as a recommendation,
Fixed a bug that the heroine who came to the restaurant and the heroine who replied to the following day's recommendation posting were different.

-Rich Vanilla
-Extra Nut Coconut
-Viennese Coffee
-Matcha Cappuccino

The heroine who replies to a recommendation post is basically the heroine who visited the store,
If you cannot remember which heroine came to the store in which flavor, please look back at the replies to your recommendation postings.

Thank you for your continued support of "Hookah Haze".

notes.title: Video introducing the adventure part is released!
notes.notes:
A new video introducing mainly the adventure part of "Hookah Haze" has been released.
Please take a look at a glimpse of the story as it progresses by providing each character with the shisha of their choice.

[previewyoutube=RQUB_TyzLGs;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, we have partially lifted the ban on information about the theme song of this work, “Hookah, whoo!” in the video. 
The song is sung by “Nakuru Aitsuki”, who is expanding her activities as a singer who goes back and forth between real and virtual. “DECO*27” is in charge of sound production and lyrics, and “tepe” is in charge of composition and arrangement.

On March 1st, during the birthday live stream of “Nakuru Aitsuki”, we plan to sing a part of the song for the first time. Please look forward to this as well.
